tools.name: get_latest_signals
tools.description: Return recent source-backed finance and technology signals, optionally filtered by topic and signal type.

tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Search signal titles, bodies, and source names. Results include provenance links when available.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Return one signal by ID, including provenance, author, topic, and comment count.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List available finance and technology topics with current signal counts.

tools.name: list_official_sources
tools.description: List allowlisted official sources, latest checks, and latest imported signals.

tools.name: get_trending_signals
tools.description: Return the transparent 14-day signal ranking based on real engagement, provenance, and recency.

tools.name: get_daily_digest
tools.description: Return signals published during one UTC calendar date.
